scope.purpose: Display a vector glyph from the application's icon set at a system size, in the current content color, decorative unless it carries a label.
useCases: An icon next to text: menu items, list rows, navigation entries, form hints (inherits the text color).
Slot content of Button (leading or trailing), sized by the button.
A meaningful icon on its own, with a label as accessible name: a status icon in a table cell, a type icon in a file list.
Five sizes from captions (xs) to empty states and feature headers (xl).
exclusions: Bundling an icon set: the application provides the glyphs (decision: Phosphor Icons is the reference set, nothing is bundled).
Interactive icons: IconButton (wave 1) owns the action, name and target size.
Multi-color or illustrative artwork, logos, avatars (Avatar, wave 5) and images.
Loading indicators: Spinner (wave 3); the Button has its own intrinsic indicator.
Icon fonts and sprite sheets: a glyph is inline vector content.
alternatives: IconButton for an action without visible text.
Badge for a status or category with text.

fixtures: Phosphor Icons 2.1.1 regular paths (plus, arrow-right, trash, download-simple, check) in examples and tests, standing in for the application's icon set.

checks.note: 4 tests: svg root and defaults, label semantics, sizes and viewBox, attribute pass-through.
4 Chromium tests: sizes in 18 contexts (270 computed records), decorative versus named, host sizing and layout, axe light and dark.

360 records (270 computed records: width, height, glyph fill per size in 18 contexts; 90 drawing-inset records), 0 failures. Justified differences listed in figma-spec.md (label, glyph source, local fixtures, color override instead of currentColor).

decisionsTaken: The glyph is content supplied by the host (a drawing), not a name looked up in a bundled set: ggbrick bundles no icons (authoring/decisions.md, Icons). The implementation exposes the drawing's coordinate box as an option so that icon sets with another grid still render.
Five sizes, bound to size.icon.{xs,sm,md,lg,xl} (12, 16, 20, 24, 32 px), density-independent as every icon size; default md to match the md Button.
Decorative by default: a lone icon without label is hidden from assistive technology; a label turns it into an image with that accessible name. No separate boolean: the presence of label decides.
No color option: the icon paints in the current content color; a host that needs another color wraps it in a colored container (as Button does through its content color).
No states and no interaction: the icon is static content.
Inside a Button slot the button's icon size wins over the size option, so that slot content always matches the button size (Button contract rule).

The reference set's 1/8 inset is a documented convention, not an option: hosts that apply optical spacing (Button) assume it; glyphs from sets with another inset are supported but sit slightly off in those hosts.

Contract gate (user, 2026-10-14): glyph passed as content with a coordinate-box option defaulting to the Phosphor grid; five sizes kept. Phosphor Icons confirmed as the reference set (nothing bundled: the application supplies the glyphs).

Implementation: the svg element is the component root (not wrapped in a span), so that hosts that select their slot's svg (Button) size and offset the Icon exactly as a raw glyph; attributes pass through to the svg.
Implementation: a blank label counts as no label (decorative), so an empty string from a binding never yields an unnamed image.

Review page: the disabled-color sample was replaced by a tertiary-color sample because disabled text on the canvas is below 4.5:1 and fails the axe audit; the test assertion follows (a page choice, not a component change).

Figma: the Icon master is a Size variant set whose Glyph is an instance-swap property defaulting to the _Fixture/Icon set (Phosphor fixtures), instead of Name variants per glyph: the glyph is content, so it is swapped, not enumerated. Size=md is the default variant. The _Fixture/Icon set stays on the Utilities page as the glyph source until a Phosphor library is attached.

implementationNotes: Svelte: Icon renders a single svg root element (class ggb-icon, data-size, viewBox option defaulting to the Phosphor grid 0 0 256 256, fill currentColor, width and height from size.icon) whose content is the children snippet. A single svg root keeps the Button slot selectors (.ggb-button__leading > svg) working, so the button sizes and optically offsets the icon as it does today with raw svg fixtures.
Accessibility: without label, aria-hidden="true" and focusable="false"; with label, role="img" and aria-label.
Layout: display inline-block, vertical-align middle, flex none, so the icon aligns with text and never shrinks in a flex row.
